note: UBCI's schedule of charges to its customers (the file its site dates 1 January 2025; its January 2026 schedule gives only a range up to the same 18 dinars): keeping a cheque account costs 18 dinars a quarter (9 for a private customer earning 1,500 dinars a month or less, a condition the game can't check, so the full fee is written); the schedule doesn't say whether the figure includes tax.

sources.title: UBCI, Barème des conditions applicables à la clientèle (file dated 1 January 2025)
sources.said: Barème des Conditions applicables à la Clientèle ... 1- Frais de tenue de compte ... a- Compte chèque compte 18/Tri (*) ... (*) 9d/trimestre pour les clients particuliers ayant un revenu mensuel net inférieur ou égal à 1500 TND
